Tuna Salad Lettuce Wrap
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 11:12pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 teaspoons classic Ceasar Salad dressing
1/2 can of tuna
2 baby carrots, chopped
2 lettuce leaves
3 olives
1/2 roma tomato
1/2 teaspoon each garlic powder
1/2 teaspoon basil leaves
1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
1/2 teaspoon salt

Preparation

1 In a small bowl, combine tuna, chopped carrot, olives, and tomato. Chop one of the lettuce leaves and add. 2 Spinkle with remaining spices, salad dressing, then mix thoroughly. 3 Using the other lettuce leaf, place tuna salad in tne center, and then fold and enjoy. 4 Submitted by: suzie
